title: On The Limited Cost of Consistency In Points-Based Rewards Programs
abstract: arXiv:2506.03911v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Points-based rewards programs are a prevalent way to incentivize customer loyalty. In theory, the effective design of these programs is shaped by two important considerations. Customer heterogeneity suggests that tailoring thresholds to different customer types may yield revenue gains, while demand uncertainty creates incentives to update thresholds over time as the seller learns how customers respond to the program. In practice, however, there may be nontrivial operational and customer-facing benefits associated with maintaining consistency along both of these dimensions. Setting a single threshold across customer types can facilitate transparent communication and reduce the legal, reputational, and operational risks associated with personalization, while avoiding threshold increases prevents the devaluation of customers' previously earned points. translated_title: 论积分制奖励计划中一致性的有限成本
translated_abstract: 基于积分的奖励计划是激励客户忠诚度的一种普遍方式。理论上，这些计划的有效设计受两个重要因素影响：客户异质性表明，针对不同客户类型定制（积分兑换）阈值可能带来收入增益；而需求不确定性则促使卖家随着对客户反应的逐步了解而随时间更新阈值。然而在实践中，在这两个维度上保持一致性可能带来不可忽视的运营和客户体验方面的好处。为所有客户类型设置单一阈值可以促进透明沟通，并降低与个性化定价相关的法律、声誉和运营风险；而避免提高阈值则可防止客户已积累积分的贬值。基于这些考虑，本文研究了积分制奖励计划中保持一致性的成本。
tldr: 本文研究表明，在积分制奖励计划中，对客户类型采用统一阈值且不随时间提高阈值的一致性策略成本有限，因此实践中出于运营和客户信任考虑而保持一致性的做法在经济上是合理的。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that the cost of consistency in points-based rewards programs—using a single threshold across customer types and avoiding threshold increases over time—is limited, justifying such practices from operational and customer-facing perspectives.
